antispam.unconfirmedTTL: How long a deferred sender is remembered while the server waits for its retry. A retry after this window counts as a new first contact and is deferred again.
antispam.confirmedTTL: How long a sender that retried and was accepted stays remembered. Its mail is not deferred again during this time.
antispam.digestInterval: Hours between two summaries for the same mailbox.
antispam.digestBaseURL: The address users open webmail at. Every release link in the summary starts with it, so it must be a full http(s) URL, and the digest cannot be enabled without it.
antispam.threshold: A message whose summed score reaches this value is filed to Junk. A domain or user threshold overrides it.
antispam.bayesProb: The Bayesian model's spam probability at or above which the Bayesian spam weight is added to the score.
antispam.saThreshold: The summed score of the SpamAssassin rules at or above which the SpamAssassin rules weight is added to the score.
antispam.zones: The DNS blocklist zones the client IP address is looked up in. A listing adds the DNSBL weight. Leave it empty to turn the check off.

limits.imapLiteral: The largest literal an IMAP client may send in one command, such as the message it uploads with APPEND.
limits.webmailPreview: The largest attachment webmail previews on its own when a message opens. A larger one is previewed only after the reader asks for it.
limits.freebusy: How many mailboxes one availability request may look up. Each mailbox costs a full calendar scan, so this limits the work of one request.

quota.storage: The mailbox size, in MiB, that mail clients see as the quota limit. Nothing is refused when the mailbox grows past it. 0 means no limit.
quota.receive: Once the mailbox is larger than this, in MiB, mail sent to it is refused as mailbox full. 0 means no limit.
quota.send: Once the mailbox is larger than this, in MiB, the user cannot send mail. 0 means no limit.

hide.gal: Hides the user from the global address list that Outlook shows.
hide.al: Stored now. It takes effect when the server offers address and member lists.
hide.delegate: Stored now. It takes effect when the server offers delegate lists.
hide.anr: Hides the user from name resolution, so a partial name typed in Outlook does not find them.

oof.start: Automatic replies start at this time. Leave it empty to start at once.
oof.end: Automatic replies stop after this time. Leave it empty to keep them on until they are turned off.

fetchmail.imapFolder: The folder read on an IMAP source. POP3 has no folders and ignores it.
fetchmail.fetchAll: Fetch every message on each poll, not only the new ones. With Keep on server this delivers the same messages again on every poll.
fetchmail.verifyCert: Check the source server's TLS certificate. Turn it off only for a server with a self-signed certificate.

mlists.type: Normal delivers to the members you enter on the list's page. Domain delivers to every mailbox of the list's domain.
mlists.whoMayPost: Whose mail the list accepts: anyone, the list's own members, senders in the list's domain, or the senders named on the list's page. Anyone (announce) accepts mail the same way as Anyone may post.

status.targetURL: The daemon's /healthz address as the admin container reaches it, for example http://imap:8090/healthz. The port is the health_addr the daemon listens on.

ldap.usernameAttr: The LDAP attribute a login name is matched against. Empty uses mail.
ldap.bindDN: The account this server searches the directory with. It reads every entry the sync imports, so give it read access only.
ldap.preset: A starting mapping for a directory schema. Reset to preset returns the mapping to it.
ldap.baseOverride: Search only under this entry for this domain's accounts. Empty uses the connection's search base.
